runner.note: The canary strings exist; nothing emits a datapoint or a log line for them to be found in. A canary that is never planted is a string in a file.

cases.title: Find no canary string in any emitted datapoint or log line
cases.note: Five canaries: prompt, secret key, file path, repository name and transcript. The case is negative because its whole content is that these must never appear; a run that finds one is the failure it exists to detect.

note: The suite is missing every positive case the harness contract names — the five OTLP identity attributes stripped inside the receiver, an unknown attribute dropped and flagged rather than passed, and a high-entropy value in an allowed field caught by the entropy scan.
